card_exclusion: physical card 7 EXCLUDED (live X25 big-E97-softplus run); never used
queue_rule: registered card if free at launch, else next-free ascending physical index; actual card receipted per-arm launch receipt; atomic idle/unleased shell leases only, no preemption

state_cell_receipt.b0_definition: B0 = ceil(141312 / (K+V)) slots, X27 small-GDN2 state-cell equivalence (key128 x value1104 = 141312)

recipe.supervision: stage1/stage2: masked cross-entropy at supervised positions (mean-per-class-recall metric); stage3: end-of-word BCE on a two-logit margin reading the final READ output (G8)
recipe.right_censoring: 60,000-update cap; a stage may complete early on its receipt gate; unused budget does not carry forward; no retries

stage2.gate: >=99% validation mean per-class recall AND receipted slot-occupancy growth (strictly increasing mean peak live slots across the registered item-count grid K in {2,4,8,16})

fine_sweep.rule: bounded tape arms only; native arms have no B and no sweep

microbatch.binding: M2-review correction F5: registered effective-batch accumulation. One optimizer step consumes exactly 64 examples; length-aware microbatches are bounded by token_budget (n_mb * max length in the microbatch) and max_sequences, chosen so the predicted peak allocation (receipts/microbatch_allocation_model.json) fits a 40-GiB rung with margin; a single example exceeding the token budget forms its own microbatch (over-plan single, receipted). Updates are identical to a single batch-64 step (summed-loss accumulation).
